facts.fact: 农场抵达：拄拐农夫（约 65 岁）与圆如汤圆、像卡通人物、系围裙的母亲相妇人（55 上下）出迎——自称 Dave 与 Doris；Doris 刚烤好 scone、要泡 Bushells 茶、后廊下午茶配杏子酱或 Tasmanian leatherwood honey——「一切都会没事」；Gretchen 一脸 smug；Ned 不吃 scone（Perth 三个 mate 等着猎袋鼠、路远）走了才松气——Carina 停止发抖；Gretchen 趁人不听时说 See, I told you so。
facts.anchor: she was as round as a dumpling, just like a cartoon figure

facts.fact: Dave 的账目核对无误：罕见风暴吹倒大片围栏（他确有左腿石膏）；每周 500 刀×两周 minus expenses、住 farmhouse 两间空房、包食宿啤酒；三人坦白 unskilled labourers——他说无妨、自己能开车监工；每周日放假去教堂「if we could find one」（不知是否玩笑）；16 岁女儿 Sharlene starved for company、见三人如见外星人。
facts.anchor: He offered us $500 per week each for two weeks’ work, minus expenses

facts.fact: 农场两周：「we weren't raped...we weren't tortured, but there was still a surprise in store」；活难、起初 incompetent→Gretchen 练成 impressive fencer；三月热 30 度多风、清晨 6:30 干活；夜里给 Doris/Sharlene 讲欧洲故事、Dave 读牛仔书、玩 board games；菜式单一（牛/羊/猪肉烤菜）——素食的 Anneliese 做过两次 vegetarian lasagne 全桌爱吃；周五结束 Dave 现场给 Gretchen 写推荐信：「Gretchen is the best damned unskilled fence repairer that I have ever come across」。
facts.anchor: Gretchen is the best damned unskilled fence repairer that I have ever come across.

facts.fact: 离别真相：Doris 抱进 maternal bosom 大哭——大女儿 25 岁在 Adelaide 死于药物过量，因此恨所有城市（crime and exploitation rife、cities＝places of depravity）、宁可孤独守乡村；三个「美丽的外国人」带来两周快乐；Sharlene 拉到一边求绑架去 Adelaide（农场生活 unbearably boring、被三人旅行故事点燃——Gretchen 的故事听得她 hair stand on end）被拒；早餐 bacon/eggs/pancakes 配「一生吃过最好的」leatherwood honey、夜里 Coopers 管够；Doris 婚姻忠告：别为钱嫁（unimportant）、别为爱嫁（love evanescent）、要为友谊嫁——找你欣赏且尊重的人，因为 married life is hard（Anneliese 至今带着这句话）。
facts.anchor: her elder daughter had died of a drug overdose at twenty-five in Adelaide

facts.fact: 结账（the reckoning，粉 laminate 厨桌）：食物啤酒每天每人 30 刀、住宿每晚每人 50 刀、14 晚合计 3360 刀 vs 应得 3000 刀——「我们倒欠 360」；但他不收钱，反而每人给一张崭新的 100 刀；Outback 的食物啤酒贵、澳洲住宿世界最贵之一；临别名言（他永生难忘）：All adventures have to be paid for; nothing comes without a cost——说完拄拐回屋读牛仔书，就此永别；三女 dumbfounded。
facts.anchor: All adventures have to be paid for; nothing comes without a cost.

facts.fact: 归途清算：Carina（后座）——「Holy shit, we were taken for a ride by the nice farmer and his nice wife. I want my thousand dollars」；Anneliese——「we were well and truly screwed by the amiable couple」；Gretchen 一路沉默后开口：「The little Aussie family were so nice to us...It all worked out so well – I had the best two weeks of my life」；她继而 high-sounding 地复读 Dave 的 adventure/cost 名言（仿佛两人是 young and useless things）——到 Adelaide 即甩掉 Gretchen 与 Statesman；Adelaide：spookily quiet、dry and deserted、「City of Churches」。
facts.anchor: I had the best two weeks of my life.

facts.fact: 收尾：Anneliese 留 email＋手机号（求澳洲出版业职位推荐——I do tell good stories）；告别互谢（good listener 难得的是 hardly ever interrupted / good storyteller）；叙述者顺手把 Xavier 的书塞进西装口袋（与 Smyg 的偷书癖暗合）；回 lounge 遇到的第一人是 Miranda——下章钩子。
facts.anchor: I grabbed one of Xavier’s books off the side table and put it in my suit-coat pocket.
